domestic_evidence: No verifiable domestic-supply record obtained. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India sales split could not be retrieved: the company website domain (comptech.co.in) did not resolve, thecompanycheck.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, and the web_search tool was non-functional during this run (connection refused), so no tender/contract page could be located. Note: the site comptechindia.com belongs to an unrelated Vadodara IT retailer ("Comptech Computer Centre") and was excluded as a false match. Domestic supply therefore recorded as unknown, not as none_found - absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a negative finding.
note: Legal entity COMPTECH EQUIPMENTS LIMITED, address 6, Ketan Industrial Estate, Anil Starch Road, Ahmedabad - matches the declared HS 841440 (air compressors) exactly: observed export HS codes are 84144030, 84144090, 84144010 and 84149019 (compressor parts), so no HS correction is needed. Role: manufacturer_trader is plausible (exports own-brand compressors while also importing Chinese compressor parts/coolers from Wuxi Jiushengyuan, Nantong Red Star, Ningbo Baosi etc.), but the manufacturer/trader split is not proven by shipment data alone. Export activity is factual, not merely declared: dated customs bills of lading to Nepal, Myanmar, Tanzania, plus repeat buyer relationships in UAE, Kenya, South Africa and Myanmar. Revenue and export value: null - no public figures found, not estimated. Sanctions/litigation not assessed (out of scope per project rules). Verdict basis: accepted, export confirmed, domestic side unverified.
